status: PROPOSED supported-environment record for the selected profile (Architect rulings #2 items 4 and 6 and the approved ingress profile); pending independent Qualification acceptance and freeze (target 2026-10-27). A change is a new versioned file.
profile: restricted Linux, single host, CPython 3.13, pydantic >= 2.12

python.note: A Python 3.12 result is supplementary and cannot qualify this profile. This workflow does not change main's mvp-chain.yml.

yama.absent: Yama unavailable means the exact profile is unsupported: the boundary test is BLOCKED and the verdict is INCOMPLETE; no weaker environment is substituted.

hub_record.refresh: Environment evidence must be refreshed (a new record) if the execution host or a relevant setting changes.

ipc.separate_ipc_directory: the socket's directory must not be, or sit under, the ingress state directory

hub_record.run_binding: The hub record is deterministic and carries no run id. The envelope (cognous.mvp-environment-record-envelope/1) carries run_id and qualification_sha supplied by the workflow (MVP_RUN_ID, MVP_QUALIFICATION_SHA), the record's own record_sha256, the sha256 of the record file, the sha256 of the capture script and of this profile; the gate requires all of them to match. Missing run_id or qualification_sha is INCOMPLETE, a different one FAIL.
hub_record.source_binding: configuration.ingress_source_sha256 must equal the sha256 of tools/mvp_ingress/*.py in the hub checkout at the tuple sha; absent is INCOMPLETE. Each component pin in the record must equal the tuple sha of that component.
hub_record.interpreter_binding: python.version must equal the interpreter version the suite observed in this run
hub_record.required_ids_note: Reconciled against the ids the hub script at the pinned sha256 emits (also verified by running it: 32 ids on a bare host, of which the always-emitted PASS-or-better set is required). Not required by name: capture.exception, <section>.exception, filesystem.state_dir_present and filesystem.socket_present (BLOCKED markers emitted only on failure; any BLOCKED check already makes the verdict INCOMPLETE). A required id absent from the record is INCOMPLETE; one that is not PASS is INCOMPLETE (BLOCKED) or FAIL.

capture_script.note: Pinned because #219 is still moving. The script in the hub checkout at the tuple sha must have exactly these bytes (a different script is a NEW candidate: new profile version and commitment), and the run envelope must name this sha256. The candidate-identity hub sha (hub main) predates the script: a run needs hub_revision set to a sha that contains it, otherwise G-11 is INCOMPLETE.

manifest.note: manifest file passed to the capture script; its sha256 must equal the record's configuration.manifest_sha256 (checked against the tuple's action-manifest checkout)

identities.note: dedicated users and group created by the workflow; names only, the uids and gids are resolved on the host and compared with the record. The ingress runs as mvp-ingress (non-root, own primary group), the client as mvp-client, the socket group mvp-ipc has exactly those two members.

provisioning.yama: sudo sysctl -w kernel.yama.ptrace_scope=1 in the workflow; absent or < 1 is BLOCKED and the verdict INCOMPLETE
provisioning.ipc_directory: a separate directory (setgid, group mvp-ipc, 2750) the client can traverse; the ingress-owned 0700 state directory is never the socket directory
provisioning.socket: 0660, owner the ingress uid, group mvp-ipc
provisioning.developer_optout: MVP_INGRESS_PROFILE=developer-optout (local only: root ingress, mode 666, uid 65534, no record); the suite records profile=developer-optout and the gate verdict is INCOMPLETE. The workflow always sets MVP_INGRESS_PROFILE=approved.

hub_record.capture: captured IN THE RUN by suites/mvp-chain/_ingress.py as root against the very ingress process the suite then attacks (not a pre-committed file); written to mvp-chain/artifacts/environment-record.json with a gate-side envelope environment-record.envelope.json
hub_record.independent_pin: There is no pre-committed environment record hash any more: the independent anchor is the pin on the capture script (above) plus the candidate commitment, which covers this profile.
hub_record.identity_binding: the identities the suite observed on the running ingress and client (uid, gid, ipc gid, non-root) must equal process_identity and ipc.stat in the record
